cmd.root: Manage server statistics that track member counts and channel data

create.desc: Create a new statistics tracker channel in a category
create.type: The type of statistics to track
create.channelType: The channel type to create for this tracker
create.category: The category where the statistics tracker channel will be created

list.desc: List all statistics trackers for this server

update.counterId: The ID of the tracker to update

delete.counterId: The ID of the tracker to delete

noAdmin.create: You need the **Administrator** permission to create counters.
noAdmin.view: You need the **Administrator** permission to view counters.
noAdmin.update: You need the **Administrator** permission to update counters.
noAdmin.delete: You need the **Administrator** permission to delete counters.

error.notCategory: Pick a category for the counter channel.
error.typeInUse: A **{type}** counter already exists for this server. Delete it first before creating another.
error.typeInUseIn: A **{type}** counter already exists for this server in {channel}. Delete it first before creating another.
error.typeInUseReuse: A **{type}** counter already exists for this server. Delete it first before reusing that type.
error.typeInUseReuseIn: A **{type}** counter already exists for this server in {channel}. Delete it first before reusing that type.
error.saveFailed: Couldn't save the counter. Try again.
error.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the counter. Try again.
error.notFound: Counter with ID `{id}` was not found.

delete.title: Delete counter and channel

`/serverstats create type:members channel_type:voice category:Stats`

list.description: All counters in this server. They update every 15 minutes.
list.commandsValue:
`/serverstats create`: add a counter
`/serverstats update`: change a counter
